The short version: JoinBrands is a UGC creator marketplace where you post jobs and creators apply to make content across platforms, and you manage the process. Tokgency is a TikTok-only managed program that runs your creator affiliate operation and is accountable for GMV. JoinBrands is great when you need content to fuel your own channels. Tokgency is the answer when you want creators driving TikTok Shop sales.

The difference matters because TikTok Shop sales come from a run system, not a batch of commissioned clips. One seller described that system as "1 to 3 hero products, a strong TikTok-exclusive offer, competitive creator commissions, consistent sample outreach, clear hooks, not rigid scripts" (@jordantwestecom on X). A marketplace hands you content; someone still has to run that loop to turn it into GMV.

What JoinBrands is

JoinBrands is a marketplace connecting brands with creators for UGC and influencer content. You post a job, creators apply, you pick and pay for content.

  • Model: self-serve marketplace, per-job.
  • Scope: broad and multi-platform, not TikTok-specific.
  • Deliverable: content you can use (and sometimes influencer posts).
  • You handle: selection, briefing, management, and turning content into sales.

It is a strong option when your gap is a supply of UGC for your ads and listings.

What Tokgency is

Tokgency is a TikTok-only growth agency plus a creator finder. We recruit, seed, negotiate, brief, manage, amplify, and report on a TikTok Shop affiliate program, and we own the GMV outcome.

Side by side

JoinBrands Tokgency
Model UGC marketplace Managed agency (+ tool)
Platform focus Multi-platform TikTok only
Deliverable Content GMV
Who manages it You Us
Best for Ad/listing content TikTok Shop sales

The core difference

JoinBrands sells you content; Tokgency drives you sales. A marketplace gives you videos and leaves the strategy, management, and selling to you, across whatever platforms you choose. Tokgency runs a focused TikTok Shop program where creators post to their own audiences and sell your product for commission. Different deliverables, different jobs.

When JoinBrands is the better pick

  • You need a volume of UGC to run your own paid ads.
  • You want content across multiple platforms, not just TikTok.
  • You are comfortable managing creators and turning content into results yourself.

When Tokgency is the better pick

  • You want creators selling on TikTok Shop, not just filming.
  • You want the program managed and someone accountable for GMV.
  • You are TikTok-Shop-focused and want a specialist, not a general marketplace.

The two can even work together: use a marketplace for ad creative and a managed program for GMV. For that distinction, see UGC platforms vs affiliate tools.

The takeaway

JoinBrands for content, across platforms, managed by you. Tokgency for TikTok Shop GMV, managed for you. Pick based on whether your gap is content or sales.

Want creators who sell, not just film? Book a call, or find TikTok Shop sellers.
